title: Cardinals OC Nathaniel Hackett declines to name rookie Jeremiyah Love starting RB as training camp opens

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals OC Nathaniel Hackett declines to name rookie Jeremiyah Love starting RB as training camp opens
sources.description: Love was the No. 3 overall pick in this year's NFL Draft, but Arizona also has James Conner and Tyler Allgeier on the running back depth chart.
